tldr: Full-record local privacy creates a dimension-dependent cost for observational ATE adjustment with unknown heterogeneous propensities. The proved results include matched dense risk and honest-length orders, evaluated but generally loose all-resource brackets, and an exact growing-dimension consistency criterion shared by noninteractive and sequential collection. This round improves testing of the specified deterministic-ATE cubic priors: a bounded sequential pilot query succeeds when \(N/d^{3/2}\to\infty\), compared with the existing noninteractive sufficient order \(d^{5/3}\). The all-channel converse guarantees indistinguishability below \(d^{4/3}\), so even this fixed-prior comparison is not matched. Full finite-resource rational risk and length frontiers remain unresolved.
gap: Categorical causal estimation, private nonlinear-functional estimation and fixed-channel causal efficiency do not yet provide a verified all-resource full-record NI/SI frontier for unrestricted heterogeneous reciprocal adjustment.
